parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Define the term:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: empty-shell marriage

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: gender role.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State two ways family life is changing.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Apart from the nuclear family, describe three types of family.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain three feminist criticisms of the nuclear family.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Discuss why many women choose to have children later in life.
Your answer should include:
• at least three developed points with evidence.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Evaluate the view that the family performs essential functions for its members.
Your answer should include:
• at least three arguments for and three arguments against
• a conclusion. 
Education

parts.text: Define the term:

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: gendered curriculum

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: pro-school sub-culture.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State two linguistic factors that can affect educational experience.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe three features of the official curriculum.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain three ways education is meritocratic.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Discuss the limitations of the Marxist view of education.
Your answer should include:
• at least three developed points with evidence.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Evaluate the view that material factors have the most influence on educational achievement.
Your answer should include:
• at least three arguments for and three arguments against
• a conclusion.

parts.text: State two aims of punishment.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe three features of strain theory.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain three reasons why crimes are not always reported to the police.

parts.label: (e)
